title: add rag agent examples and docs quickstarts
author: Maya Chen
description: Add RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) agent templates, tool-calling examples, and quickstart docs. Motivation: provide engineers with ready-to-run examples to onboard RAG workflows (embedding store + retriever + agent tool-calls) and to standardize recommended prompt/temperature defaults. This PR includes: 1) runnable example repos under redwood-examples/rag-agent-playbooks (Python + TypeScript) 2) short quickstarts added to redwood-quickstarts describing end-to-end setup: index, retriever, agent, and monitoring 3) docs site updates to redwood-docs with new pages and sidebar entries 4) small SDK helper added to redwood-sdk-python to simplify tool registration in the agent. Checklist: - [x] Add Python and TS example playbooks - [x] Add docs quickstart pages and TOC entries - [x] Add SDK helper and unit tests - [x] Update examples CI to run smoke e2e in CI - [x] Performance smoke: confirm latency within expected bounds on hosted environment Related: ENG-2148 (RAG playbooks), PM-378 (quickstart content), SUP-9123 (customer asked for examples). Notes: kept code changes minimal and isolated to examples and docs; no runtime changes to serving layer.
commits: Docs: add quickstarts and sidebar entries
